EventCard.tsx was removed from the measured set after cycle-impl-02: its attendee and registration branches belong to SPM-61/SPM-138 tests outside this scope; the full frontend `npm run test:cov` (23 Oct 2026) measures it at 100% statements, branches, functions and lines.
